deviations: The paper's full control list is in the online appendix, which is not available; controls were reconstructed: incomes = respondent and second-adult income percentiles with kinks at the 20th and 70th percentiles (p, min(p-20,0), min(p-70,0)); estimated gains = simule_gain and its square; sociodemographics = sex, age bracket, socio-professional category, education (4), town size, region, consumption units, number aged 14+, smoker, main news source; other motives = belief the tax is effective (not 'No') in Tables 4 and 6, and the initial win/lose category in Table 8.
All regressions use the survey weights (weight) and heteroskedasticity-robust SEs.
Table 6 subsample built as respondent percentile in [10,60] or (more than one adult and second-adult percentile in [10,60]); this gives 1,961 observations versus 1,969 in the paper.
Effectiveness information treatment Z_E identified as the apres_modifs indicator (the random half-split whose first-stage effect on believing in effectiveness is about 6 p.p.).
notes: Data: s (3,002 respondents) from after_preparation.RData; memisc-classed columns were stripped to base vectors because memisc is not installed in the sandbox. Attempts 1-4 were exploratory (object/column listing and variable tabulations; attempts 2-3 crashed on memisc classes during exploration and printed no RESULT lines). Attempt 5 was the first estimation script and crashed on a type error (TRUE/FALSE-coded Yellow Vests columns stored as character); fixed and rerun as the final run. The final run's values were compared with the claims via check_attempt ('All claims within tolerance'); the script was not changed afterwards, so no claim attempt is recorded. Table 4: RDD LPM on the 1,968 feedback recipients (757 with |gain|<50), quadratic in estimated gain; col 3 adds interactions with initial acceptance, Yellow Vests supporter (part of or supports the movement), and initial not-lose belief plus initial win/lose category controls. Table 6 col 1: 2SLS of targeted-dividend acceptance on believing one does not lose, instrumented by T1, T2, T1xT2 with policy-threshold FE, single-adult indicator and initial acceptance. Table 8 col 1: 2SLS of initial approval on believing the tax effective ('Yes'), instrumented by the effectiveness and climate-change information treatments. No docker run hung.
